title: Cosmic Dreamer
description: A surreal night scene features a giant female profile with a swirling galaxy for hair floating in the starry sky. Below her, a small girl in a patterned dress stands on a cliff edge gazing upward, surrounded by levitating potted trees, blue constellation orbs, and a large face in the clouds above a mountain range.
prompt: Surreal night scene with a giant female profile floating in the starry sky, her hair formed from a swirling blue galaxy and constellations. A small girl in a white patterned dress stands on a rocky cliff edge looking up at her. Between them are levitating potted trees with white outlines, glowing blue orbs showing a house and symbols, and a large face formed in blue clouds above a stylized mountain range, all in a black and blue cosmic palette.
